product.description: flexible LED strip 5 mm wide - Nichia 757G series mid-power LEDs - warm white 2700 K - CRI 90 - 24 V - 2 m reel

light.beamName: bare strip without optic: each LED emits into the half space, near Lambertian

electrical.control: constant-voltage 24 V supply; dimmed by a DALI PWM dimmer ordered separately

housing.mounting: self-adhesive, laid in a slot at least 6 mm high: the pond lip's rim-light slot (Salon specification, section 3.8)

photometricFile.note: The maker publishes no LDT or IES file for a bare strip; a bare strip is a line of near-Lambertian emitters.

sources.title: Lumistrips, SlimFlex3090 Nichia LED Strip 5mm wide (product page, which lists the 2700 K sibling 56027 at 1950 lm/m)
LEDRise, SlimFlex3090 Nichia LED Strips 5mm width (variants 56027 2700 K 1950 lm/m 18 W/m, 56026 4000 K 2120 lm/m)

unverified: The strip's height of 1 mm and its 120 degree beam are from the maker's page for the 4000 K sibling; the 2700 K page was not read directly.
The cutting interval (33 mm on the maker's page) decides how closely a length can follow a drawn run; it is not recorded as a field.
Whether a DALI PWM dimmer is the maker's recommendation: the pages name no dimming method.
